name: qarinah
description: Qarinah is proof-carrying project memory for coding agents - multi-language, worktree-aware, recoverable, and cited.

interface.longDescription: Qarinah gives every initialized Git worktree its own evidence-linked memory, builds a multi-language source graph, records lifecycle-bound receipts and recoverable checkpoints, and groups sibling checkouts into one repository context graph. It captures explicitly permitted Codex lifecycle metadata into a local tamper-evident record, while read-only MCP tools report status, integrity, and compact cited task context.
defaultPrompt: Build a cited context pack for this task.
Show the decisions related to this change.
